card.name: Hyphenated time units before intervals
card.fires_on: The hyphenated time unit (-month, -week, -hour, -minute) right after a number, when the next word is likely "intervals" or a similar span word. Seen in dosing and monitoring schedules.

modes.label: Repeat-at-intervals schedules
modes.description: A number plus a hyphenated unit describing how often a dose or test is repeated.
modes.example: Obtain liver function studies initially and repeat at 24<<-hour>> intervals.

modes.description: A number plus a hyphenated unit for a follow-up or waiting period.
